title: Museum service walk finish

source_context.document_identity: UFGS 32 16 19 — Concrete Sidewalks, Curbs and Gutters; May 2018; downloaded edition references UMRL July 2026
source_context.note: Sidewalk finishing includes transverse broom texture.
source_context.use: Factual paraphrase of a guide specification, not a project requirement unless adopted in synthetic records.

paragraphs.text: The service walk needs a grippy broom finish, not the polished appearance of the indoor lobby. Please price the walk and the small pad separately.
The existing lobby is smooth. The outdoor walk is shaded and the customer wants the brush lines across the direction of travel. This record does not assess regulatory compliance.
Approved: small equipment pad gets its existing smooth finish. The service walk gets transverse broom finishing; the lobby sample is for color only.
We could use the same finishing crew on both pours. No finish substitution has been authorized.
Equipment pad: smooth finish to match existing.
Service walk: smooth steel-trowelled finish to match the lobby sample; color as selected.
